stories.headline: Google DeepMind launches Gemini 4 Argon, its new flagship model
stories.blurb: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Argon, positioning it as their next-generation frontier AI model. The company frames this as entering a 'new era' of intelligence capabilities, though specific benchmarks and availability details weren't provided in the announcement.
stories.why_it_matters: Google's first major model release since Gemini 2.0, signaling renewed competition at the frontier.
stories.original_headline: Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence

stories.headline: ElevenLabs just doubled its valuation to $22 billion
stories.blurb: The AI voice company hit $22 billion in a $300 million employee tender co-led by Wellington and T. Rowe Price — double its previous valuation. ElevenLabs makes text-to-speech and voice-cloning tools used by publishers, game studios, and app developers to generate realistic AI voices at scale.
stories.why_it_matters: Voice AI is now a top-tier startup category alongside foundation models and coding agents.
stories.original_headline: AI voice startup ElevenLabs doubles valuation to $22B

stories.headline: Shopify lets you build a store by talking to an AI agent
stories.blurb: Shopify's new Canvas builder lets merchants create and customize entire online stores by chatting with Sidekick, its AI agent. You describe what you want, and watch the site build itself in real time—no coding or template wrestling required.
stories.why_it_matters: First major platform to ship conversational store building, not just page tweaks
stories.original_headline: Shopify debuts Canvas, a way to build online stores by chatting with AI

stories.headline: Amazon just redesigned every Kindle with edge-to-edge color displays
stories.blurb: The new Kindle lineup — base, Paperwhite, and Colorsoft — all got thinner, lighter, and now feature seamless edge-to-edge color screens. It's the first time Amazon's put color on the entire range, not just one premium model.
stories.why_it_matters: E-readers are finally catching up to phones on design and color, making them viable for more than just text.
stories.original_headline: Amazon introduces a completely redesigned Kindle family

try_this_prompt.title: The energy audit
try_this_prompt.prompt: Look at my calendar for the past two weeks. I'll paste it below. Tell me which recurring meetings are costing me more energy than they generate in value, which one-off commitment I should never have said yes to, and what pattern in my schedule is quietly burning me out.
try_this_prompt.tool_hint: Run this monthly before resentment becomes your default mood.
